negative_snippets: The hotel is average, I have paid extra for a big room, but the rooms there were so bad, walls with tobacco (gutka) spits make it worse. The staff was ok, not rude. If someone is paying extra for a big 'good' room, trust me all the rooms are the same, all the rooms have gutka spit walls. Honestly, I wouldn't have paid more than 500 for this room. The location very off, it's in the between of residential area. I don't know why so much of good reviews are there for this property.
